entities.name: Volrath
entities.description: A human from Dominaria born as Vuel who became the shapeshifting, phyrexianized evincar of Rath and a main antagonist of the Weatherlight Saga.

entities.name: Vuel
entities.description: The human form of Volrath, what was left of him after his Phyrexian implants were removed; executed at Crovax's coronation.

entities.name: Sidar Kondo
entities.description: Vuel's father, who rejected him after his failed rite of passage.

entities.name: Gerrard Capashen
entities.description: A boy accepted into Vuel's family who became his friend and later his enemy; kills Volrath's shapeshifted double and defeats him on Mercadia.

entities.name: Starke il-Vec
entities.description: A man who poisoned Vuel's ritual paintings, then comforted him and opened a portal to Rath; murdered by Volrath on Mercadia.

entities.name: Karn
entities.description: A silver golem deactivated by Vuel with the Touchstone and later captured by Volrath on Rath.

entities.name: Sisay
entities.description: Captain of the Weatherlight, abducted by Volrath's order to lure the ship to Rath.

entities.name: Takara
entities.description: A Weatherlight companion whose form Volrath shapeshifted into to stow away aboard the ship.

entities.name: Tahngarth
entities.description: A Weatherlight crew member taken captive by Volrath on Rath.

entities.name: Crovax
entities.description: Contender for the throne of Rath who defeats Volrath in a duel and becomes evincar.

entities.name: Ertai
entities.description: A contender for the throne of Rath who intervenes on Crovax's behalf and kills Vuel with flowstone.

entities.name: Greven
entities.description: A contender for the abdicated throne of Rath.

entities.name: Belzenlok
entities.description: A demonlord who takes control of The Cabal and claims he had been evincar instead of Volrath.

entities.name: Yawgmoth
entities.description: Phyrexian ruler whose words of power Vuel heard before giving himself to Phyrexia.

entities.name: Rath
entities.description: A strange world reached through Starke's portal, ruled by Volrath as evincar.

entities.name: Dominaria
entities.description: Vuel's homeland.

entities.name: Mercadia
entities.description: The plane where Volrath, disguised, turned the Weatherlight's crew against each other.

entities.name: Weatherlight
entities.description: A skyship that Volrath lured to Rath and later tried to steal.

entities.name: Phyrexia
entities.description: The artificial plane Vuel gave himself to, becoming Volrath.

entities.name: Revolution on Mercadia
entities.description: The uprising on Mercadia during which Gerrard defeated Volrath in combat.

entities.name: The Cabal
entities.description: A faction taken over by Belzenlok, who made his home in the ruins of Volrath's stronghold.

events.summary: Vuel's trial of climbing a plateau is sabotaged by Starke's poison; Gerrard saves his life, and Vuel is cast out of his clan, even by his father.
events.quote: Vuel was cast out of his clan as a failure, with even his father rejecting him.

events.summary: Vuel rallies barbarians against his former clan, causing many deaths including his father's, and deactivates Karn and steals the Legacy artifacts.
events.quote: Vuel managed to deactivate Karn using the Touchstone and steal The Legacy artifacts.

events.summary: Vuel is transported to Rath through Starke's portal, gives himself to Phyrexia, and becomes Volrath, evincar of Rath.
events.quote: he gave himself to Phyrexia , becoming Volrath, the new evincar of Rath, a shapeshifter and master of flowstone manipulation.

events.summary: Volrath has Sisay abducted to lure the Weatherlight to Rath, ambushes it, and captures Tahngarth, Karn and the Legacy artifacts; Gerrard falls over Skyshroud Forest.
events.quote: He organized the abduction of Sisay to lure Weatherlight to Rath

events.summary: Gerrard kills a shapeshifted Volrath decoy; the real Volrath, in Takara's form, stows away on the Weatherlight.
events.quote: Volrath had shapeshifted into the form of Takara, which enabled him to stow away aboard Weatherlight as it fled the Stronghold.

events.summary: On Mercadia Volrath turns the crew against each other, murders Starke, and tries to steal the Weatherlight.
events.quote: He then took his revenge by murdering Starke and attempting to steal Weatherlight .

events.summary: During the Revolution on Mercadia, Gerrard beats Volrath, who survives, pursues the Weatherlight, is defeated again and retreats to Rath.
events.quote: Volrath survived and pursued Weatherlight aboard Recreant

events.summary: Volrath returns to find his throne contested by Greven, Ertai and Crovax, and duels Crovax; Ertai's intervention lets Crovax win.
events.quote: Ertai had intervened on Crovax's behalf, off-balancing Volrath and allowing his opponent to secure his victory.

events.summary: At Crovax's coronation Vuel, stripped of his Phyrexian implants, is executed with flowstone manipulated by Ertai.
events.quote: Vuel was injected with a vial of liquid flowstone

events.summary: Centuries later Belzenlok takes control of The Cabal, lives in Volrath's ruined stronghold and rewrites history to claim he had been evincar.
events.quote: Belzenlok rewrote Dominaria's history, claiming that he had been Evincar instead of Volrath.

relations.note: Volrath is the Phyrexianized identity of Vuel.
relations.quote: Volrath , born as Vuel , was a human from Dominaria
Vuel was born as the son of Sidar Kondo

relations.note: Volrath resented Gerrard and sought revenge.
relations.quote: Volrath, therefore, resented Gerrard for not simply letting him die.
He then took his revenge by murdering Starke and attempting to steal Weatherlight .

relations.note: Gave himself to Phyrexia after hearing Yawgmoth's words.
relations.quote: Hearing Yawgmoth 's words of power, he gave himself to Phyrexia

relations.note: Duelled Volrath to the death for the throne.
relations.quote: Volrath entered the contest himself and challenged Crovax's accession in a duel to the death.
which Ertai manipulated within his bloodstream to disassemble Vuel from the inside out
